about.title: Electricians you can trust in Pearland.
text: Look no further, you have arrived to your Complete Electrical Solutions. Servicing residential and commercial customers in the greater Houston area, we are your solution for electrical repairs, electrical upgrades and new electrical installations.

As trained, licensed, certified and insured technicians, each of our team members ensure safe and reliable services. It is our promise to you to follow industry standards, implement best practices, and meet all city and state codes to ensure the job is done right the first time, every time.

We enjoy our work. We get great satisfaction and sense of accomplishment in meeting and exceeding our customers' expectations. We don't cut corners nor do we rig things up to save time. Everything we do is up to national and local electrical code, and it is this pride in our workmanship that sets us apart from others. That is why we get the job done right the first time, with honesty, integrity and the commitment to our customers.
